headline: Leclerc gets a five-second penalty for contact with Lawson in Brazil
body: The stewards ruled Leclerc caused the contact and that it helped him pass Lawson five corners later, moving Lawson up to seventh. The penalty was five seconds rather than ten because of the wet conditions and the minor nature of the contact.

headline: Antonelli gets a five-second penalty for an unsafe release in Brazil
body: Mercedes released Antonelli into the path of Colapinto in the pit lane, and he lost control on the slippery surface. The penalty does not change his fifth place, which he finished more than 20 seconds clear of Piastri. Bearman received the same penalty for an unsafe release, with no change to his 17th place.
